message.reasoning_content:
Round 3 action. Cash 36.5M is top. Devaluation: cash floor(cash/100)*62 → losing 38%. Options: bribe for influence? Influence gives extra 5% bank share at end and presidency. Bribes convert cash 5M→1 influence, but bribe money goes to recipient — costly. Devaluation makes spending now attractive: spending 30M now avoids devaluation loss? Actually roof/donkey.

Donkey: 1 alashi for 1 good — cheap relative to boom prices (~12+ per unit next market). Buy several? Donkey gives 1 good per action, only one action per round. So donkey gives 1 good for 1 alashi, sells at ~10-12 → good. Produce gives 2 goods free. Produce better.

Shuttle: 3 goods, 25% confiscation risk. Expected 2.25 goods. Produce gives 2 free, keeps cash. Shuttle gives expected +0.25 goods, small. With boom, fine—but risk. Produce is safe.

Consider bribe: cash 36.5M devalues to ~22.6M anyway; bribing 5M to gain 1 influence → influence helps presidency and 5% bank. But money to rival. Meh. Produce is solid.
